admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Hearth record, east parlour. The quarter's inspection of the east parlour hearth was carried out by the hearth keeper: the flue was swept from the roof irons down, the firebrick was sounded along the back and both cheeks, and the damper was worked through its full travel and left set for the season. The sweeping cloths were shaken out and folded back into the hearth box, and the fender was set back on its chalk marks. The record was routed to the duty reviewer in the usual way. The heading of this record is marked closed, yet the disposition line at its foot stands empty, and the margin carries the duty reviewer's note to hold the record for a further look. The hearth may be used as normal through the quarter, and the next inspection falls at the next quarter day.
